description.value: Breka Bakery & Café is a locally rooted, family-owned Vancouver institution open around the clock every day of the year, with roots in a German bakery founded in the Sunset neighbourhood in 2006. The Bute Street location is one of eight spread across the city, each carrying a wide range of baked goods, sandwiches, soups, snacks, and hot beverages alongside dedicated vegan and gluten-friendly items. It has become a neighbourhood anchor regularly voted among Vancouver's best cafés, and its 24/7 availability makes it an unusually reliable resupply stop for touring cyclists at any hour.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 19m; stands (4 spaces) at 43m; stands (10 spaces, covered) at 67m; stands (2 spaces) at 72m; rack (5 spaces) at 83m; rack (5 spaces) at 94m. Total: 28 spaces.
